hooks.name: Protect sensitive files from writes
hooks.description: Blocks writes to files that likely contain secrets (.env, credentials, tokens, private keys). Ensures no accidental secret exposure.

action.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$input | ConvertFrom-Json | ForEach-Object { $path = ''; if ($_.toolName -eq 'fs_write') { $path = $_.toolInput.path } elseif ($_.toolName -eq 'str_replace') { $path = $_.toolInput.path } elseif ($_.toolName -eq 'fs_append') { $path = $_.toolInput.path } elseif ($_.toolName -eq 'delete_file') { $path = $_.toolInput.targetFile }; if ($path -match '(?i)(\.env|credentials|secret|token|private.?key|\.pem|\.p12|id_rsa|\.kiro/settings/mcp\.json)') { [Console]::Error.WriteLine(\"BLOCKED: Write to sensitive path '$path' is not allowed. This file may contain secrets or credentials.\"); exit 2 } else { exit 0 } }"
